jobs.title: Data Analyst II - Merchandising Analytics
jobs.description:
Tailored Brands
is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brands include Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore
, which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About The Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst II – Merchandising Analytics
to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. You will serve as a vital role as a “data detective” investigating trends underlying KPIs to uncover the "why" behind performance. Collaborating with buying, planning, and promotional teams, you will go beyond retrospective reporting to identify who is impacted and what it means for our future. Your proactive, forward-looking insights will guide, monitor, and measure key merchandising and planning strategies.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities

Data Analysis: Dive deep into sales, inventory, and customer data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
Reporting: Create clear, concise, and insightful reports and dashboards for stakeholders.
Inventory Management: Provide insights to help develop and execute seasonal and annual merchandise buying plans.
Visual Merchandising: Collaborate with planning and visual merchandising teams to optimize product placement and availability.
Pricing Insights: Analyze pricing strategies and elasticities to provide recommendations for adjustments.
Promotional Effectiveness: Evaluate the impact of promotions on sales and customer behavior.
Market Analysis: Analyze market trends to identify new opportunities for increasing sales.
Forecasting: Use statistical models to create forward-looking prediction models.
Presentations: Present analyses in a clear, interpretable, and applicable way that can be shared widely, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in statistics, business, merchandising, or a related field is required.
Minimum of 3 years career experience in a similar role
SQL: Proficiency in querying databases for data extraction is required.
Data Visualization: Experience visualizing insights in enterprise Business Intelligence tools effectively is required, preferably in Power BI.
AI Tools: Ability to use tools (such as CoPilot and Glean) to amplify, but not replace thinking, in work is required.
Python/R: Proficiency in scripting data manipulation and modeling for analysis is preferred.

Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach daily
Able to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally
Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment
Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location

Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go Tailoredbrands.com/working-here/people-culture.

Work-Life Balance

Responsibilities

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:

Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development
Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend

Perform routine equipment inspections, maintenance, and operational checks.

Experience with utility locating, surveying, or infrastructure documentation.
Familiarity with GPS/GNSS data collection equipment.
Experience working in utility, telecommunications, construction, or engineering environments.
Knowledge of underground utility infrastructure and utility safety practices.

Ability to work outdoors in varied weather conditions.

Ability to safely enter active construction and utility work environments.

Primarily field-based position.
Frequent travel to project locations.
Work may occur near roadways, utility infrastructure, and active construction sites.
Occasional overnight travel may be required based on project needs.

• Experience with data QA/QC processes and data cleaning
• Familiarity with spatial data, ideally using ArcGIS affiliated software but not required

• Experience presenting findings and recommendations to stakeholders, management, and subject matter experts
• Interest and enthusiasm for power systems, safety, and risk modeling

jobs.description:
At Mott MacDonald, we believe that engineering is about more than solving problems, it’s about shaping a future that’s inclusive, resilient, and sustainable. As we expand our operations across the US and Canada, we’re inviting passionate individuals to join us in a journey that’s driven by purpose and powered by brilliant people. We’re trusted consultants, partnering with clients to solve complex challenges and deliver lasting impact.

From the moment you join our team, you’ll be surrounded by experienced engineering consultants, project managers, and subject matter experts who are committed to excellence and innovation. You’ll work side-by-side with mentors and peers who champion integrity and teamwork, because we know collaboration drives better outcomes – and you won’t just apply your engineering skills, you’ll also embrace the mindset of a consultant.

Together, we’ll tackle complex challenges, deliver sustainable solutions, and create positive change for our clients and the communities they serve. You’ll be trusted to contribute, encouraged to grow, and supported every step of the way.

As a participant in our brand‑new graduate program, Blueprint
, launching in October 2026, you’ll embark on a structured three‑year development journey designed in collaboration with an award‑winning learning provider. The program blends immersive learning experiences with mandatory development sessions to build the professional, commercial, and personal effectiveness skills to equip graduates to thrive and lead in our business.

Your responsibilities may include:

Log soil and rock borings (hollow-stem auger, mud rotary, sonic) in accordance with ASTM D2488 and the USCS; log rock core per ISRM/Caltrans conventions
Observe and document CPT soundings, test pits, and geophysical surveys (e.g., suspension P-S logging, MASW)
Collect and preserve soil and rock samples (SPT, Modified California, Shelby tube, core runs) with proper labeling and chain-of-custody
Perform field classification, pocket penetrometer, and torvane testing
Monitor groundwater levels; install and develop piezometers and monitoring wells under senior supervision
Coordinate USA/DigAlert utility clearances, drilling subcontractors, and site access ahead of fieldwork
Conduct site reconnaissance and geologic mapping, including documentation of surficial conditions, slope features, seeps, and existing distress
Maintain daily field reports, photo logs, and quantity tracking for drilling and construction activities
Assist with seismic hazard evaluations: fault mapping review (Alquist-Priolo zones), CGS Seismic Hazard Zone maps, liquefaction and seismic settlement screening, ground motion parameters per ASCE 7 and CBC guidelines
Perform preliminary engineering geology research: review of geologic maps (CGS, USGS), historical aerial photographs, prior reports, and grading records
Support slope stability, settlement, and bearing capacity analyses under the direction of a Geotechnical Engineer
Draft sections of geotechnical investigation reports, geologic hazard reports, and fault investigation reports
Assist with the preparation of figures, site plans, and boring location maps

To be considered for this 2026 opportunity, here’s what you’ll need:
Bachelor’s Degree in Geology.
Knowledge of AutoCAD 2017 or higher
Self-motivated and able to work as part of a team.
Geologist-in-Training (GIT) certification, or the ability to obtain GIT certification within 12 months
The desire to work toward and obtain California PG and CEG licensure
Demonstrated interest in your chosen field through previous internships, volunteering opportunities, or organization memberships
Creative thinking skills, with a methodical and pragmatic approach to problem solving
Proficient communication and presentation skills to engage confidently with clients and colleagues
Resilient, solution-oriented mindset, with a focus on continuous growth and delivering value
Ability to build and maintain relationships and rapport with internal and external stakeholders
Collaborative spirit and commitment to teamwork
A valid California Driver’s license

This position is located in Los Angeles
, California
. You must be able to reliably commute to our office in this location, per our hybrid working policy.

We’re more than engineers - we’re changemakers. At Mott MacDonald, you’ll find:
Best in class learning and development initiatives
Dedicated mentorship program
Network of Employee Resource Groups
Opportunities for excellence everyday

We welcome individuals who are driven by curiosity, compassion, and a desire to make a difference. If you’re excited by the idea of working in an engineering consultant that values your growth and empowers you to lead with integrity, we’d love to hear from you.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the US, as Mott MacDonald is unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

Benefits & Reward

At Mott MacDonald, our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, providing them with a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses. We provide a comprehensive benefit package that includes 401k, medical, dental and vision insurance, short-term/long-term disability, paid holidays, PTO, parental leave, and company paid life insurance.

Individual pay is determined based on several factors such as work location, education, experience, and unique skills.

Problem-solving with a purpose.

Great pay and general compensation structures

401k program

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Project Coordinator to join our Digital Marketing team. In this role, you will help keep marketing projects organized, on schedule, and moving forward by coordinating tasks, maintaining project documentation, following up with stakeholders, and ensuring deadlines are met. You'll work closely with the Digital Marketing Operations Manager and Digital Marketing Project Manager to support initiatives across web, email marketing, content, paid advertising, SEO, creative, analytics, and other digital marketing efforts. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys organization, problem-solving, and keeping multiple projects running smoothly in a fast-paced environment. You'll gain hands-on experience working across a wide variety of digital marketing initiatives while collaborating with designers, developers, copywriters, analysts, and other cross-functional teams.

Experience coordinating projects, managing timelines, or supporting project management in a marketing, creative, or digital environment.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.

Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple teams.

jobs.description:
WebMD Health Services is part of the WebMD family. We have been designing well-being programs for employers and health plans for over 20 years. Our mission is to empower organizations and their populations to improve well-being through personalized, strategic partnerships.

Overview:

WebMD Health Services (WHS) is a division of WebMD whose mission is to provide expert guidance that inspires people to take charge of their health. We do this by helping people understand their health risks, make smart health care decisions, and take active steps toward living healthier lives. Our health, well-being and dedicated services power programs from employers, health plans and government organizations and are delivered online, onsite, and telephonically. Learn more at webmdhealthservices.com.

WebMD is an Equal Opportunity Employer of Minorities, Females, Protected Veterans, and Individuals with Disabilities.

Position Description:

The Dedicated Well-being Program Coordinator (PC) will work collaboratively with the designated client’s health promotion team to raise awareness of the onsite program and the WebMD products and services that support it. This full-time position is remote, and located in the Seattle, Washington area with travel to worksites weekly
to raise awareness, host events and implement programs. This role requires weekly travel up to 4 days per week
to regional worksites. All travel is conducted during standard work hours. No overnight stays or weekend travel is required
.

The PC is responsible for client satisfaction, retention, and reference-ability. They will act as a customer advocate, as well as a point of contact with senior client stakeholders to increase participant engagement and maximize value delivered through the WebMD relationship. They will engage in program coordination and promotion duties and can provide support for program planning, strategy, and impact assessment. The PC will proactively identify opportunities for service delivery enhancement and improvement. As opportunities are identified, the PC will work with other Client Services team members to improve processes and develop new solutions.

The successful candidate will have a background in a health-related field (Examples: health promotion, exercise physiology, and/or nutrition).

In this role you will:

Increase awareness and engagement in client-wide well-being offerings.
Provide referrals to appropriate resources for participants.
Assist with building a culture of health through offering programs at worksites.
Assist with the day-to-day delivery of the well-being program with direction from the client and WebMD account team.
Establish relationships and buy-in from key stakeholders.
Manage and support the Well-being Champion Network, including assisting with events, initiatives, reporting and promotions.
Provide ongoing project management for onsite programs and promotional events.
Track and report on all participant-facing activities (Examples: tabling events, champion support).
Work closely with internal and client teams to provide ongoing program performance review and support.
Create meaningful and engaging content for promotional support of the client’s well-being program.
Coordination of meetings and other communications (internal and external).
Develop and maintain schedules necessary to support the successful execution of client health education programs.
Assist the client and internal account team with other tasks as needed.

Qualifications, skills, and experience:

BA/BS required.
Minimum of 2 years’ Wellness Coordinator or similar experience required.
Demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple relationships with multiple client stakeholders in a dynamic environment.
Experience managing Wellness Champion Networks.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Strong program planning and reporting skills.
Strong content creation and presentation skills.
Familiarity with Google Workspace, Canva, and the Microsoft Office suite including Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

Preferred:

Professional Certification from National Wellness Institute (NWI), The National Commission for Health Education Credentialing (NCHEC), or the equivalent certification.

Note: This is an hourly role: $24 - $27.00 hr.

As a member of WebMD Health Services, you may have access to confidential and sensitive information (including Protected Health Information) that will require you to follow additional protocols to ensure the security of our data. As a core requirement, you must implement and act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies; protect assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference; execute security processes or activities; and report security events or potential events or other security risks to the appropriate parties within the organization.

Ability to open manholes
Performs other related duties as assigned or requested

1-2 Years’ experience with GIS and/or GPS field collection of utilities
Ability to interpret engineering/utility As-built drawings

1-2 years using GPR equipment and EMF Locating Equipment
Experience w/ DoD GIS

Experience with mapping underground utilities preferred

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

SoundCloud is looking for a strategic Senior Data Analyst to join our Data & Insights team. As a Senior Data Analyst, you will collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure accurate data capture, translating that data into insights that drive product innovation and monetization. You will use your advanced SQL skills, analytical mindset, and storytelling abilities to uncover user behavior patterns, identify opportunities, and measure the impact of new features/functionality through experimentation. You will also create dashboards and insights reports to communicate your findings and recommendations to various stakeholders, from product managers and engineers to leadership and executives.

Drawing on your strong commercial sense, you’ll partner across functions to shape the product and go‑to‑market decisions that fuel the expansion of our content ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Leverage content economics, subscription performance, and user behavior data to deliver strategic recommendations to product and business stakeholders; define and track core KPIs to guide critical product and business-lifecycle decisions.
Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify the opportunity space for the product teams based on user needs, preferences, pain points & friction in the user journeys.
Design and execute hypothesis-driven experiments on creator tools and features to maximize user growth, engagement, and retention.
Communicate data-driven insights & recommendations to product, engineering, design, and leadership teams using clear and compelling narratives, visualizations, and presentations.
Partner across finance, strategy, and commercial leadership to track core business performance, investigate tactical or strategic shifts in revenue and performance metrics, and deliver data-driven insights that support operational efficiency and strategic business decision-making.
Collaborate with other analysts, data engineers, data scientists, and product managers to ensure data quality, consistency, and alignment across different data sources and platforms
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and documentation to share best practices, learnings, and institutional knowledge across the organization.

Experience And Background

5+ years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, data science, or a related field. Direct experience within Commerce, subscriptions, freemium based businesses, streaming services, Social, Commerce, Gaming is a plus.
Expertise in SQL and experience working with large-scale data sets on cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS.
Experience with analytics engineering tools such as Apache Airflow, Dataform, dbt, etc.
Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
Familiarity with event tracking, design and tag management solutions such as Segment, GTM, Adobe Launch, Tealium, etc.
Experience in designing, running, and analyzing complex A/B tests and experiments using one or more of the leading experimentation solutions. i.e. StatSig / Optimizely / Target.
Strong analytical skills and ability to apply statistical methods such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, clustering, forecasting. Experience building churn and retention prediction models is a plus.
Excellent communication skills and ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations for different audiences.
Curiosity and passion to find & elevate the data narratives and exercise influence to drive change.
Experience in mentoring and training analysts and non technical stakeholders.
Passion for music and interest in understanding user behavior and preferences in the music domain.

The salary range for this role is $130,000 - $150,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below!

About Us

We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits

Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
Robust 401k program
Employee Equity Plan
Generous professional development allowance
Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children
Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. Lafayette Group is seeking a dynamic, experienced, and highly motivated individual to support the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) with managing and developing strategic data products, coordinating stakeholder meetings and strategic communications efforts, and conducting a variety of strategic, operational, and business process analyses related to performance measures and metrics. Data Strategy: Support establishment of a comprehensive data framework for collecting, managing, and utilizing data effectively. Support data collection, ensure data quality and security, and align data practices with the goals and vision. Extensive experience with Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service.

Metric Design: Assist in developing performance metrics that are well-designed, meaningful, and aligned with strategic objectives. This involves defining clear measurement criteria, establishing benchmarks and targets, and designing metrics that provide actionable insights and drive continuous improvement efforts.
Gap Analysis: Work as part of a team to review existing dataset and compare it against the data required to meet organizational goals. By identifying gaps in the available data, the team can gain insights into where additional data collection or refinement is needed.
Carries out processes for the transfer and integration of data across different systems and platforms, enabling real-time access to accurate and current information for data-driven decisions.

jobs.description:
Summary

This position is located within the (CNRMA) Fleet and Family Readiness Department (N944) Facilities and Construction Division. The mission of this position is to administer a region wide program for' the planning, project nomination, programming, design, construction, repair, renovation, alteration, conversion, and maintenance of FFR facilities. The primary purpose of this position is to provide ,project management for the construction or renovation of facilities across CNRMA.

Duties

Help

Construction Project Management duties include but are not limited
to:

This position is assigned the primary responsibility for managing the Non­ appropriated Fund (NAF) Capitalization Program. Oversees and administers the CNRMA NAF Capitalization Board (NCB) announcing the annual project data call, ensuring the prescribed Project Nomination Form (PNF) is current, reviewing submissions, preparing inputs for Office of General Council (OGC) review, reviewing the scoring criteria with NCB members, scheduling a NCB meeting to vote on submissions, coordinating the meeting with site Morale, Welfare and Recreation (MWR) Directors, scoring the results and preparing a point paper and board results for chain of command approval. Approved projects may be executed by N94 Facilities & Construction assets, who take the lead on design and execution, or with outside contractors. Approved projects may also be executed by CNIC N94 contracting.
In collaboration with Installation Program Directors assists in the development of project goals and coordinates understanding and agreement on the overall scope, objectives, risks, costs and timelines defining project goals.
Assesses the feasibility of NAF construction projects and quantifies information to give decision makers an objective and data-driven assessment to assist in prioritization of proposed NAF projects. Provides ROM estimates in the initiation stage to assist in determining the feasibility of moving forward on a project based on the estimated level of effort in terms of completion time and cost. During project conception phase the incumbent provides initial guidance on the critical tasks necessary for ensuring a projects success.
Assists in preparation of project nominations. Facilitates the Project Validation Assessment (PVA) team's site assessments to determine program user needs/facility demands, and operational analysis. Utilizes Navy Facility Asset Data Store (NFADS) database to review information regarding the evaluation of existing facilities, physical condition, functional adequacy, compliance with applicable safety regulations, etc. Reviews the PVA draft-and final reports for accuracy/feasibility.
Identifies efficiencies and cost-effective measures related to non-appropriated fund (NAF) FFR construction efforts with focus on preparation and validation of documents related to and in support of the design/build process.
Has knowledge and understanding of MWR funding categories and assists in the proper identification of resources needed to support the objectives of the project
Prepares statements of work (SOW) for solicitation and contract types, Coordinates required documents from local Base (Non-appropriated Fund Instrumentality, Public Works (PW), Facilities Engineering and Acquisition Division, or Naval Facilities Engineering Command (NAVFAC)). Prepares evaluation plans for complex procurements or those that exceed the simplified acquisition threshold. May prepare independent government estimates for new work and modifications to award documents.
Identifies requirements and assists with procurement negotiations . Assures compliance with contractual requirements related to the scope of service, schedule, budget, and performance time requirements.
Corresponds with the activity PW office on construction issues that impact the development of project(s) in order to resolve issues at the earliest possible time, enabling adequate control of costs and/or time extensions at the progran1ming level, prior-to actual execution.
Reviews A/E submissions, specifications, cost estimates, technical planning documents, project documentation, and project status reports involving new construction, repair, renovation, alteration, and expansion of facilities, to ensure these meet request for proposal intent, specifications, and constructability. Coordinates A/E design development with commercial A/E firms (e.g. coordinates meetings to review different phases of design and construction); NAVFAC; and Navy, non-Navy Department of Defense (DoD) agencies, and other governmental agencies.
Participates as Design Manager (entails program specific requirements/specifications i.e. fitness, FFSC) when assigned to NAVFAC executed NAF or Military Construction (MILCON) projects. Participates in source selection and technical evaluation boards for NAF and appropriated fund (APF) projects.
Supports the Regional Facilities & Construction Coordinator as needed in the day­ to-day operations of the NAF Recapitalization Projects. Assists with data collection, verification of accuracy, and transfer to reports and briefings for upper­ level management and new employees within the enterprise. Reports may be data calls, status reports, and briefings for the annual Non-Appropriated Fund Construction (NAFCON) program as it moves through the approval process.

Requirements

Help

Conditions of employment

Must pass all applicable records and background check.
Must successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. Any discrepancies must be resolved as a condition of employment.
Starting May 7, 2025, non-affiliated individuals requesting access will need a REAL ID-compliant driver's license or another acceptable form of identification to access CNRMA Installations. (review required documents section for more information.)
Must be able to obtain and maintain a valid state driver's license

Qualifications

Resumes must include information which demonstrates experience and knowledge, skills, and ability (KSAs) as they relate to this position. Applicants are encouraged to be clear and specific when describing their experience level and
KSAs.

A qualified candidate must possess:

Knowledge of and the ability to apply engineering concepts, principles and practices applicable to a range of engineering disciplines (i.e, civil, mechanical, electrical, structural, architectural, environmental) required for the design, layout, execution processes of construction operations in order to monitor compliance with and provide input on construction projects.
Knowledge of the principles, concepts, practices, and techniques of administration of NAF Capital Programs to include design, operations, and management of recreation, community support, lodging, and/or MWR business-based activity facilities.
Knowledge of environmental and economic considerations along with industry trends in recreation, community support, lodging, and/or MWR business-based activity facilities.
Knowledge of DoD planning, programming, and budgeting for NAF and APF budgeting and accounting systems and applicable laws, rules, regulations, directives, and instructions.
Knowledge of the organization1 structure, and operation methods of DoD, Department of the Navy (DON), CNIC, NAVFAC, local commands, etc., in order to appropriately frame inquiries and provide responses related to the planning and execution of assigned project(s)/tasks.
Knowledge of acquisition methodologies currently in use within industry and government.
Skill in preparing SOW for construction projects including new SOW and modifications for change orders in accordance with current codes and regulations.
Skill in the use of standard industry software (e.g., AutoCAD).
Ability to interpret construction guidance specifications to ensure compliance with requests for proposals, SOWs, contracts, and related project documents.
Ability to coordinate construction and renovation projects.
Ability to analyze project specifications, proposals, construction plans, etc.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.

Examples of qualifying specialized experience include technical work in: drafting, surveying construction estimating, physical science, mathematics, aerospace, architecture, chemicals, electrical or mechanical systems, mining, petroleum, or nuclear systems.

Experience in a trade or craft may be credited as specialized experience when the work provided intensive knowledge of engineering principles, techniques, methods, and precedents. Examples are trade positions with substantial developmental, test, or design responsibilities such as:

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Project Coordinator to join our Digital Marketing team. In this role, you will help keep marketing projects organized, on schedule, and moving forward by coordinating tasks, maintaining project documentation, following up with stakeholders, and ensuring deadlines are met. You'll work closely with the Digital Marketing Operations Manager and Digital Marketing Project Manager to support initiatives across web, email marketing, content, paid advertising, SEO, creative, analytics, and other digital marketing efforts. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work.

Professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
Genuine interest in digital marketing, operations, and continuous process improvement.

Education And Experience Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.
1–3 years of experience in project coordination, project management, marketing operations, or a related role.

Certification in project coordination or project management (e.g., CAPM) is a plus.
Previous experience in healthcare, pharmacy, or another regulated industry is preferred.
Experience using project management software, with monday.com experience preferred.

SoundCloud is looking for a strategic Senior Data Analyst to join our Data & Insights team. As a Senior Data Analyst, you will collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure accurate data capture, translating that data into insights that drive product innovation and monetization. You will use your advanced SQL skills, analytical mindset, and storytelling abilities to uncover user behavior patterns, identify opportunities, and measure the impact of new features/functionality through experimentation. Drawing on your strong commercial sense, you’ll partner across functions to shape the product and go‑to‑market decisions that fuel the expansion of our content ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Leverage content economics, subscription performance, and user behavior data to deliver strategic recommendations to product and business stakeholders; define and track core KPIs to guide critical product and business-lifecycle decisions.
Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify the opportunity space for the product teams based on user needs, preferences, pain points & friction in the user journeys.
Design and execute hypothesis-driven experiments on creator tools and features to maximize user growth, engagement, and retention.
Communicate data-driven insights & recommendations to product, engineering, design, and leadership teams using clear and compelling narratives, visualizations, and presentations.
Partner across finance, strategy, and commercial leadership to track core business performance, investigate tactical or strategic shifts in revenue and performance metrics, and deliver data-driven insights that support operational efficiency and strategic business decision-making.
Collaborate with other analysts, data engineers, data scientists, and product managers to ensure data quality, consistency, and alignment across different data sources and platforms
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and documentation to share best practices, learnings, and institutional knowledge across the organization.

5+ years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, data science, or a related field. Direct experience within Commerce, subscriptions, freemium based businesses, streaming services, Social, Commerce, Gaming is a plus.

Excellent communication skills and ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations for different audiences.

Experience in mentoring and training analysts and non technical stakeholders.
Passion for music and interest in understanding user behavior and preferences in the music domain.

A Bed for Every Child is a program of the Massachusetts Coalition for the Homeless, working to provide brand-new beds to Massachusetts children who don't have one of their own. Build in the workshop.
